detected_problem: Resolve current debt, long-term debt, cash and finance leases
financial_definition: Net debt: total debt (LongTermDebtNoncurrent + DebtCurrent) less combined cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash; finance leases are not reported and are treated as zero.
statement_or_note_reference: 2026-09-30 10-Q XBRL balance-sheet debt facts and Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
accounting_explanation: The original extraction mislabeled DebtCurrent (17,028M) as the current portion of long-term debt; the debt fair-value note indicates the current portion of long-term debt was approximately $6.6B at 2026-09-30, with the remainder of DebtCurrent being short-term borrowings/commercial paper. Total debt is still supportable as LongTermDebtNoncurrent + DebtCurrent = 38,925M. No finance-lease liability is reported, so finance leases are treated as zero. The cash value used is the combined cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash amount of 15,365M. Net debt is therefore total debt less that combined cash balance.
